 This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India Praying To
Quash The Impugned Notice/Direction Dated 28.03.2022
Directing The Petitioner To Handover The Gold
Ornaments, Produced As Annexure-A As Bad In Law
And Arbitrary.
 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing, This Day, Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice E.S.Indiresh
 Oral Order
1.
Learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice for the respondent.

2. In this writ petition, petitioner is assailing the notice dated 28.03.2022 issued by the respondent under S.91 of Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking information / production of material in respect of the Crime No.35/2022 for the offences NC: 2025:KHC:44800 HC-KAR punishable under Sections 403, 406, 409, 420, 380 read with S.34 of Indian Penal Code.

3. Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, I am of the view that, since, by the impugned order the respondents have sought certain information by issuing notice at Annexure-A to the petitioner, no interference is called for in this writ petition.

However, it is open for the petitioner to approach the competent Court in the event, if the petitioner suffers any adverse action by the respondents.
4.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
